text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"That sushi chain in front of the station 
is quite popular over in America too."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
While it's a popular casual restaurant in 
Japan, it's actually treated as a high-end 
Japanese diner over there, fufu.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If you understand what is known as "market 
value" and seize your chance, business is 
bound to succeed.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Seize the Chance, properly analyze, and 
take the action of challenging—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This too is an essential element for 
seizing the American Dream!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Oops. All this talk about sushi is making 
me hungry... What do you say? Care to 
continue this in the cafeteria? Hehe♪
